$comment: 语法大厅 G35（V0.9 P3 进阶层，从句四课之三）。比喻锚点：舞台提示：什么时候进、什么条件下进。只讲初中层面（时间六词/if·unless、主将从现、while 段 when 点、not...until、两个 if 分家），不堆砌复杂例外；原因/结果/让步/目的/比较留给 G36。全部内容原创。
title: 状语从句一（时间与条件）
metaphor: 舞台提示：什么时候进、什么条件下进
ketNote: 老实说：KET 只在阅读里见到 when/if 的简单说法，不考「主将从现」这类变换。这是初中和 PET 的重头戏——这课为它打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 舞台提示写「何时进、什么条件下进」；主句将来，提示里用现在。
sections.why: 演出脚本上除了乐谱，还有一类小字：「主唱进副歌时，鼓手加入」「如果观众安静下来，灯光调暗」。这就是状语从句——它不是演出本身，只负责给主句定位：什么时候发生、什么条件下发生。中文里这类话随口就说，动词也不用变；英语却有一条反直觉的规矩：主句是将来时，when/if 提示里偏偏用一般现在——I'll call you when I arrive，不说 when I will arrive。道理其实简单：主句的 will 已经把「将来」报过了，提示只是坐标，坐标不用再报一遍时。初中和 PET 大量考这条；KET 只要求看懂。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团排新曲，指挥让学徒把进场安排写成舞台提示。学徒写：「When the singer will start the chorus, the drummer joins.」指挥把 will 划掉：「提示是给演出定位的坐标——演出报时（will），坐标不报时。将来的事，提示里也写现在：When the singer starts...」学徒又写条件提示：「Unless the hall doesn't get quiet...」指挥又划：「unless 这个词自带一个『不』字，你再塞一个 don't，等于把否定叠了两层，谁也看不懂到底要不要安静。」最后一条：鼓手问自己几点能走。指挥写下：You won't leave until the last note fades——「until 是『一直到』；想说『才』，就得让主句先背上 not。」

cards.detail: when（当…时）· while（正当…期间）· before（在…之前）· after（在…之后）· as soon as（一…就）· until（直到）。
cards.example: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

cards.detail: if（如果）· unless（除非，= if ... not，自带否定）。
cards.example: If it rains, we'll practise inside.

cards.detail: 主句是将来时，when/if 等提示里用一般现在表将来——will 不进提示。
cards.example: The show will start when everyone is ready.

cards.detail: 一下子的动作用 when；一段进行中的背景用 while，常配 be + -ing（G14 的两件套）。
cards.example: While we were playing, the lights went out.

cards.detail: 「一直做到」用肯定 + until；「到那时才做」必须让主句背上 not。
cards.example: I won't leave until the rain stops.

cards.detail: 「是否」的 if 坐宾语座位（G33），该用 will 就用 will；「如果」的 if 是舞台提示，遵守主将从现。
cards.example: I don't know if he will come; if he comes, I'll cheer.

basic.en: When I got home, Mum was cooking.
basic.cn: 我到家时，妈妈正在做饭。

basic.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
basic.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家。（rains 用现在替将来）

basic.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
After we finish practice, we often play games.
basic.cn: 练完琴后我们常玩游戏。

basic.en: Wait here until the light turns green.

mid.en: While Dad was cooking, I was setting the table.
mid.cn: 爸爸做饭的那会儿，我在摆碗筷。（while 配一段）

mid.en: Unless you practise, you won't improve.
mid.cn: 除非你练习，否则不会进步。（unless 自带否定）

mid.en: The audience stood up as soon as the song ended.
mid.cn: 歌一结束，观众就站了起来。

mid.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave the hall.
I didn't go to bed until I finished the letter.
mid.cn: 我直到写完信才去睡。（not ... until）

trap.en: I will tell him the news when he comes back.
trap.cn: 他一回来我就告诉他这个消息。
trap.note: 主将从现——提示里用 comes 替将来，不写 will。

trap.en: If it is sunny tomorrow, we'll have the picnic.
trap.cn: 明天天晴的话我们就去野餐。
trap.note: 明天的事，if 提示里照样用 is。

trap.en: I don't know if he will come; if he comes, I'll cheer.
trap.cn: 我不知道他来不来；他要是来，我就欢呼。
trap.note: 两个 if 同台——「是否」座位里用 will，「如果」提示里用现在。

trap.en: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the first song.
trap.cn: 除非你抓紧，否则会错过第一首歌。
trap.note: unless 自带否定——后面不再加 not。

trap.en: The baby didn't stop crying until Mum picked her up.
trap.cn: 宝宝直到妈妈抱起来才不哭。
trap.note: not ... until——「才」的否定落在主句上。

trap.en: While we were rehearsing, the lights went out.
trap.cn: 正当我们排练时，灯灭了。
trap.note: while 配进行中的一段；突发的短动作留给主句。

redBlack.bad: Unless you don't practise, you can't join the band.（想说：除非你练习）
redBlack.good: Unless you practise, you can't join the band.
redBlack.why: unless 自带「不」——再加 don't 成了绕口的双重否定，听的人不知道到底要不要练。

redBlack.bad: I'll leave until nine o'clock.（想说：九点才走）
redBlack.good: I won't leave until nine o'clock.
redBlack.why: 「才」必须 not ... until——少了 not，意思成了「一直走到九点」，谁也听不懂。

redBlack.bad: I will call you when I will arrive.
redBlack.good: I will call you when I arrive.
redBlack.why: 主将从现——when 提示里不报时，用现在替将来。

redBlack.bad: If it will rain tomorrow, the match will be put off.
redBlack.good: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be put off.
redBlack.why: 「如果」提示同样不写 will——rains 用现在替将来。

redBlack.bad: We'll go out as soon as the rain will stop.
redBlack.good: We'll go out as soon as the rain stops.
redBlack.why: as soon as 也是舞台提示——stops 不带 will。

redBlack.bad: Please close the windows before you will leave.
redBlack.good: Please close the windows before you leave.
redBlack.why: before / after 提示里同样不报时。

redBlack.bad: While I watched TV, the phone rang.（想说：正看着电视时）
redBlack.good: While I was watching TV, the phone rang.
redBlack.why: while 配一段进行中——be + -ing 两件套别拆（G14）。

redBlack.bad: When I was a child, I'm afraid of the dark.
redBlack.good: When I was a child, I was afraid of the dark.
redBlack.why: 提示在过去，主句跟着在过去——半路不转调（G15）。

redBlack.bad: We didn't start until everyone arrives.（叙述昨天的事）
redBlack.good: We didn't start until everyone arrived.
redBlack.why: 整句在过去——until 提示跟着用过去式。

redBlack.bad: While the phone rang, I was cooking.（想说：电话响的那一下）
redBlack.good: When the phone rang, I was cooking.
redBlack.why: 短促的一响是时间点——用 when；while 是给「一段」的提示。

redBlack.bad: If it rains, we will stay in.（有人说 if 从句必须放句首）
redBlack.good: 前后都行：We will stay in if it rains.
redBlack.why: 舞台提示位置自由——放句首加逗号，放句尾不用；考试不设坑。

redBlack.bad: We'll leave when the show is over.（有人说必须用 after）
redBlack.good: when / after / as soon as 这里都通。
redBlack.why: 几个时间提示词常可互换，意思只差一点点——不挡意思不设坑。

contrast.cn: 明天下雨我们就不去了。（「明天」直接说）
contrast.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.（rains 是现在时）
contrast.diff: 中文动词无时态；英语偏在「如果」里禁用 will——主将从现。

contrast.cn: 我到了就给你打电话。（一个「就」字）
contrast.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
contrast.diff: 中文靠「就」表先后；英语用 as soon as 提示词加现在时。

contrast.cn: 除非你练，否则进不了乐队。（「否则」再否定一次）
contrast.en: Unless you practise, you can't join.
contrast.diff: 中文「除非…否则…」两头呼应；英语 unless 一词包办，后面不再加 not。

contrast.cn: 他直到九点才回家。（一个「才」字）
contrast.en: He didn't come home until nine.
contrast.diff: 中文用「才」；英语用 not ... until——否定词落在主句上。
中文一个「当」通吃；英语按时间的形状分成两个词。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 提示定位不报时：主将从现；unless 自带不，「才」要 not...until。
steps: 认出提示：when / if / before / after / as soon as / until / unless 领起的半句是舞台提示，不是演出本身。
主句是将来时？提示里改用一般现在——will 不进提示。
「除非」用 unless——它自带否定，后面不再加 not。
「直到…才…」：主句背上 not，not ... until 成对出现。
选 when 还是 while：一下子的点用 when；一段进行用 while，配 be + -ing。
分清两个 if：「是否」坐宾语座位（该 will 就 will）；「如果」是舞台提示（主将从现）。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『如果…就…』接龙：我说条件你接结果——『如果明天下雨』『我们就在家搭积木』，然后你把整句翻成英语。我不懂英语没关系，我只当检票员听一件事：『如果』那半句里不该出现 will 的音——听到 If it will，我就喊『提示不报时』。」再玩一轮时间版：『你一到家』『就给奶奶打电话』——听听 as soon as 后面是不是干干净净的现在时。最后加一道听力题：我说『他直到十点才睡』，看孩子把 not 放在哪半句——放对了（He didn't sleep until ten）才算过关。
questions: 「明天如果下雨我们就在家」——if 那半句为什么用 rains 而不用 will rain？
unless 是什么意思？它后面为什么不能再加 not？
「他直到十点才睡」，英语的 not 加在哪半句上？

sections.echo: 「主将从现」常被当成英语的怪例外，其实正是规律本身：舞台提示是给主句定位的坐标，一个坐标系只需要一个人报时——主句的 will 已经把「将来」说清，提示再报一遍就是重复。「一句话只发一张报时执照」这条分工，从 G30 的非谓语到这里的从句，换着面孔一再出现，这就是英语的秩序。而规律的另一面照旧：when、if、until 这些最常用的小词个个身兼数职——if 既是「如果」又是「是否」，when 既能提问又能当提示——越常用的词职务越多。演出说明还有其余几类：为什么进、进成什么样、顶着什么进、为了什么进，下一课 G36 接着讲。

stages.name: 认一认 · 读懂舞台提示

questions.q: If it rains, we'll stay at home. 哪半句是舞台提示？
questions.explain: if 领起的半句给主句定条件——舞台提示。

questions.q: 状语从句（舞台提示）的作用是？
options: 标注主句何时/什么条件下发生
questions.explain: 它不是演出本身，只负责定位。

questions.q: 「一…就…」用哪个提示词？
questions.explain: as soon as——一…就。

questions.q: 「直到」用哪个提示词？
questions.explain: until——一直到某个时刻。

questions.q: 「除非」用哪个提示词？
questions.explain: unless = if ... not。

questions.q: unless 相当于？
questions.explain: 它自带一个「不」字。

questions.q: 主句是将来时，when / if 提示里用什么时态？
questions.explain: 主将从现——提示定位不报时。

questions.q: I'll call you when I ___.（我一到就打给你）
questions.explain: when 提示里用现在替将来。

questions.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll go boating.（天晴的话）
questions.explain: if 提示里不写 will——is sunny。

questions.q: 强调「正当…的一段时间里」，用哪个词？
questions.explain: 一段进行中的背景——while。

questions.q: while 后面常配什么形态？
questions.explain: while 配一段——G14 的两件套。

questions.q: 「直到妈妈回来我才睡」——「才」的 not 加在哪？
questions.explain: not ... until——否定落在主句。

questions.q: 提示放在句首时，和主句之间加什么标点？
questions.explain: If it rains, we'll stay in.——句首提示后加逗号。

questions.q: Wait here ___ the light turns green.（直到）
questions.explain: 一直等到绿灯亮——until。

questions.q: ___ you hurry, you'll miss the bus.（除非）
questions.explain: 除非你抓紧——Unless。

questions.q: 「如果」的 if 和「是否」的 if，哪个要遵守主将从现？
questions.explain: 宾语座位里该用 will 就用 will（G33）；舞台提示才不报时。

stages.name: 选一选 · 提示不报时

questions.q: I will tell him the news when he ___ back.
questions.explain: 主将从现——comes。

questions.q: If you ___ hard, your dream will come true.
questions.explain: if 提示里用现在——work。

questions.q: We'll start the show as soon as everyone ___ ready.
questions.explain: as soon as 提示不报时——is。

questions.q: Please turn off the lights before you ___ the hall.
questions.explain: before 提示里不写 will。

questions.q: ___ it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman.
questions.explain: 如果下雪——If；snows 用现在。

questions.q: You won't improve ___ you practise every day.
questions.explain: 除非天天练——unless 自带否定。

questions.q: I won't leave ___ the rain stops.
questions.explain: not ... until——雨停才走。

questions.q: ___ we were rehearsing, the lights went out.
questions.explain: 一段进行中的背景——While + were rehearsing。

questions.q: When the phone rang, I ___ a shower.
questions.explain: 电话一响是点，正洗澡是段——was taking。

questions.q: After the concert ___, we'll go for noodles.
questions.explain: after 提示里用现在替将来——ends。

questions.q: I'll wait here until you ___ back.
questions.explain: until 提示不报时——come。

questions.q: When I was little, I ___ afraid of thunder.
questions.explain: 提示在过去，主句跟着在过去。

questions.q: We didn't start the game until everyone ___.
questions.explain: 整句在过去——arrived。

questions.q: ___ you leave, please close the windows.
questions.explain: 走之前关窗——Before。

questions.q: If Amy ___ free this Sunday, she will join us.
questions.explain: if 提示里——is。

questions.q: The audience stood up as soon as the song ___.
questions.explain: 过去的叙事——ended。

stages.name: 改一改 · 划掉多余的 will

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（他一回来我就告诉他）
options: I'll tell him as soon as he comes back.
I'll tell him as soon as he will come back.
I'll tell him as soon as he came back.
questions.explain: 主将从现——comes。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（明天下雨的话演出就取消）
options: If it rains tomorrow, the show will be cancelled.
If it will rain tomorrow, the show will be cancelled.
If it rained tomorrow, the show will be cancelled.
questions.explain: if 提示里用 rains；主句 will be cancelled（G29 被动）。

questions.q: 哪一句否定不重复？（除非你努力，否则不会进步）
options: Unless you work hard, you won't improve.
Unless you don't work hard, you won't improve.
Until you work hard, you won't improve.
questions.explain: unless 自带「不」——不再加 don't。

questions.q: 哪一句「才」写对了？（我直到十点才睡）
options: I didn't go to bed until ten.
I went to bed until ten.
I didn't go to bed after ten.
questions.explain: not ... until——否定落在主句。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（你走之前请关灯）
options: Please turn off the lights before you leave.
Please turn off the lights before you will leave.
Please turn off the lights until you leave.
questions.explain: before 提示不报时；until 意思就变了。

questions.q: 哪一句配段配对了？（正当我们排练时，停电了）
options: While we were rehearsing, the power went off.
While we rehearse, the power went off.
When we were rehearsing the power will go off.
questions.explain: while + 两件套 were rehearsing；突发动作在主句。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（等大家都到齐我们就开始）
options: We'll begin when everyone is here.
We'll begin when everyone will be here.
We'll begin when everyone were here.
questions.explain: when 提示里用 is。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（如果你觉得累就休息一下）
options: If you feel tired, have a rest.
If you will feel tired, have a rest.
Unless you feel tired, have a rest.
questions.explain: if + 现在时；unless 意思就反了。

questions.q: 哪一句点段分对了？（电话响的那一刻我正在做饭）
options: When the phone rang, I was cooking.
While the phone rang, I was cooking.
When the phone rang, I cooked.
questions.explain: 一响是点用 when；背景是段用 was cooking。

questions.q: 哪一句「才」写对了？（直到雨停我们才出发）
options: We didn't set off until the rain stopped.
We set off until the rain stopped.
We didn't set off unless the rain stopped.
questions.explain: not ... until 成对出现。

questions.q: 哪一句不转调？（小时候我住在乡下）
options: When I was young, I lived in the countryside.
When I was young, I live in the countryside.
When I am young, I lived in the countryside.
questions.explain: 提示在过去，主句跟着在过去（G15）。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（除非下雨，比赛照常进行）
options: The match will go on unless it rains.
The match will go on unless it will rain.
The match will go on until it rains.
questions.explain: unless 提示里也不报时——rains。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（演出结束后我们去吃面）
options: After the show ends, we'll go for noodles.
After the show will end, we'll go for noodles.
After the show ending, we'll go for noodles.
questions.explain: after 提示里用 ends。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（一收到票他就会告诉我们）
options: As soon as he gets the ticket, he'll tell us.
As soon as he will get the ticket, he'll tell us.
As soon as he got the ticket, he'll tell us.
questions.explain: as soon as + gets——现在替将来。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（如果她有空，她会来帮忙）
options: If she is free, she will come to help.
If she will be free, she will come to help.
If she be free, she will come to help.
questions.explain: if + is；will 只留在主句。

questions.q: 哪一句提示写对了？（等你到了给我发消息）
options: Send me a message when you arrive.
Send me a message when you will arrive.
Send me a message if you arrived.
questions.explain: 祈使主句 + when 提示用现在。

stages.name: 用一用 · 按提示进场

questions.q: 两空：If it ___ tomorrow, we ___ the picnic inside.
questions.explain: 提示用现在 rains，主句报时 will have。

questions.q: 大考：I'll stay with the drums ___ the truck comes, and ___ it arrives, we'll load them together.
questions.explain: 先「一直守到卡车来」，再「它一到就装车」。

questions.q: You'll miss the beginning ___ you leave right now.
questions.explain: 除非你现在就走——unless。

questions.q: 两空：___ I was practising, Mum came in and asked when I ___ finish.
questions.explain: while + 进行的一段；asked 过去→宾语座位里 would（G33 对表）。

questions.q: Don't open the door until the music ___.
questions.explain: until 提示不报时——stops。

questions.q: When the bell ___, the students ___ out of the classroom.
questions.explain: 过去叙事前后一致——rang / rushed（G15）。

questions.q: 两空：He won't be happy ___ he hears the news, but he'll understand ___ we explain.
questions.explain: 听到时（when）不高兴；如果解释（if）就会理解。

questions.q: ___ you finish your homework, you can't play games.（不写完不能玩）
questions.explain: 除非写完——Unless you finish。

questions.q: I was listening to music ___ someone knocked at the door.
questions.explain: 敲门一声是点——when；前半句已是一段进行。

questions.q: 两空：Please wait ___ the song is over; ___ you leave now, you'll disturb others.
questions.explain: 等到歌结束（until）；如果现在走（if）。

questions.q: As soon as the rain ___, the children ran out to play.
questions.explain: 过去的叙事——stopped。

questions.q: 两空：___ it gets dark, the street lights come on; they stay on ___ the sun rises.
questions.explain: 天一黑就亮（when）；一直亮到日出（until）。

questions.q: 找错：下面哪句的 will 放错了地方？
options: I'll call you when I will get home.
I don't know when he will get home.
He will get home at six.
questions.explain: 第一句「当…时」是舞台提示不报时；第二句「何时」坐宾语座位，will 合法（G33）。

questions.q: Mum didn't have dinner ___ Dad came back from work.
questions.explain: 直到爸爸回来才吃——not ... until。

questions.q: 两空：___ you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.
questions.explain: 普遍事实的条件句——两边都用一般现在。

questions.q: 大考二：___ the concert began, the hall was full; ___ it ended, nobody wanted to leave.
questions.explain: 开演之前已坐满；结束之后没人想走。

detective.sentence: I'll tell you the answer when I will find it.
detective.fixed: I'll tell you the answer when I find it.
detective.clue: 主将从现——舞台提示里不写 will。

detective.sentence: If it will snow tomorrow, we'll build a snowman.
detective.fixed: If it snows tomorrow, we'll build a snowman.
detective.clue: 「如果」提示同样不报时——snows 用现在替将来。

detective.sentence: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
detective.fixed: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
detective.clue: unless 自带「不」——再加 don't 就成双重否定了。

detective.sentence: I'll leave the hall until the show ends.
detective.fixed: I won't leave the hall until the show ends.
detective.clue: 想说「结束才走」——「才」必须 not ... until，否定落在主句。

detective.sentence: While the doorbell rang, I was washing dishes.
detective.fixed: When the doorbell rang, I was washing dishes.
detective.clue: 门铃一响是时间点——用 when；while 留给一段进行。

detective.sentence: After you will finish the report, please send it to me.
detective.fixed: After you finish the report, please send it to me.
detective.clue: before / after 提示里也不写 will。

detective.sentence: When I got home, Mum cooks dinner.
detective.fixed: When I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.
detective.clue: 提示在过去，主句别跳回现在——半路不转调（G15）。
